question: Which of the following Acts is also known as Morley-Minto Reforms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Councils Act, 1909**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Councils Act, 1909**

 
 
• The Indian Councils Act, 1909, is known as **the Morley-Minto Reforms**, named after the then **Secretary of State for India, John Morley, and the Viceroy, Lord Minto.**
 
• This Act aimed to introduce a series of reforms in the governance of British India to **increase the participation of Indians in the administration**.
 
• It provided for the expansion of the legislative councils at both the central and provincial levels, introducing the principle of separate electorates for Muslims by which Muslims could elect their own representatives.
 
• It also **allowed for the first time the association of Indians with the executive councils of the Viceroy and Governors**.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Act
 Details
 
 

 Government of India Act, 1935
 Provided for the **establishment of an All-India Federation and provincial autonomy**, introduced bicameralism in seven out of eleven provinces.
 
 

 Government of India Act, 1919
 Known as the **Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms**, it aimed at increasing Indian participation in governance through the **introduction of dyarchy in the provinces**.
 
 

 Indian Councils Act, 1892
 It **increased the number of additional members in the legislative councils** but maintained the official majority. It also **introduced the system of indirect elections**.
